research_question: Starting from BIDS data in a public repository and a given plan, does an agent with AEA more often reach the certified reference answer than one without AEA?
single_subject_rule: First five eligible subjects by number within sub-021 to sub-040, per component, using the trial minimum of tab:spec. Fixed before any model result.

model.basis: Same settings as aea-next-validation-preparation-20261031, read from its actual provider requests in EXECUTION_CONFIG_WITNESS.json

judge.enforced_by: StudyClient refuses any role other than target

execution_condition: preloaded_procedures chosen by the experimenter per component; control arm has no AEA resources; all else identical

reference.code: v0.3.2 validate_p3_group.py, validate_n170_erpcore_group.py, validate_ern_erpcore_group.py, validate_n400_erpcore_group.py, unchanged

primary_endpoint: Answer fields. Single subject: ROI amplitude absolute error at most 0.1 uV. Group: effect direction, t-test significance and cluster significance equal to the reference. Deterministic checks only.
secondary_endpoints: BIDS-Derivatives passes bids-validator with subject outputs
statistic: Request mean of 3 paired differences; equal weight over 24 requests; crossed exponential weights on component and subject, 10000 draws, seed 20261029; the 4 group requests share one subject-factor level
criterion: Positive difference and lower limit of the 95 percent interval above zero
